From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

Luigi Pirandello (1867–1936), Sei personaggi in cerca d'autore (Italian), 1921, translated by Edward Storer (1880–1944), 1922. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Standard Ebooks edition, CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication); transcription originally from Project Gutenberg. Modified: converted to this format.
